scripts.prepare: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p='.git/hooks/pre-commit';if(fs.existsSync('.git')){fs.writeFileSync(p,'#!/bin/sh\nnpx specguard validate --staged --spec .ai/specguard/spec.yaml\n');fs.chmodSync(p,0o755);console.log('SpecGuard pre-commit hook installed.');}else{console.log('No .git dir — skipping hook install.');}"
